title: What a Renter's Travel Protection Answers on a Challenged Car Rental Recharge
content:
Part of the amount open to challenge on a hire booked under the Car Rental Rate Classes may be answered by
the renter's own policy under the Travel Protection Plans. What decides it is the rental damage benefit carried by the
policy the renter holds in force: the limit that benefit carries, and whether it carries a deductible.

**Where the renter holds a travel protection policy in force whose rental damage benefit carries a limit at
or above the amount open to challenge and carries a deductible**, 60 per cent of the amount open to
challenge is answered by that policy.

**Where the renter holds a travel protection policy in force whose rental damage benefit carries a limit
below the amount open to challenge**, 60 per cent of that limit is answered by it.

**Where the renter holds no such policy in force**, no part of the amount open to challenge is answered by
travel protection.

## What each case requires

The first case asks two things together: the limit must stand at or above the amount open to challenge, and
the benefit must carry a deductible. A policy whose limit stands at or above that amount but carries no
deductible meets neither case, because the second asks for a limit below it.

The second case measures the 60 per cent on the limit rather than on the amount open to challenge, so a
policy with a small limit answers a small part.

| Rental damage benefit of the policy in force | Answered |
| --- | --- |
| limit at or above the amount open to challenge, with a deductible | 60 per cent of the amount open to challenge |
| limit below the amount open to challenge | 60 per cent of that limit |

## Two limits compared

Where the amount open to challenge is 900 USD and the renter's policy in force carries a rental damage
benefit with a limit of 1500 USD and a deductible: 60 per cent of 900 USD, which is 540 USD, is answered.
Where the limit is 400 USD: 60 per cent of 400 USD, which is 240 USD, is answered.
